messages:
Aisha: quick design ask — updating the tooltip for the 'Batching' toggle in Settings > Inference. goal: explain the cost vs latency tradeoff in ~1 line for most users, and a 1-sentence screen-reader friendly expansion. pinging @Tom @Ravi @Jordan for accuracy and edge cases

Aisha: two drafts below. want wording that's simple, accessible, and fits ~120px tooltip width. also want a short alt (aria) string. which reads best to you?

A) "Reduce per-token cost by grouping requests. May increase latency for single requests."
aria: "Batching reduces per-token cost by combining concurrent requests; it can increase latency for individual requests."

B) "Lower token cost for concurrent workloads — may raise tail latency (p95/p99)."
aria: "Batching lowers cost for concurrent traffic, but can increase tail latency such as p95/p99."

Tom: i like A for clarity, it's plain english. my only nit: 'single requests' might be ambiguous — maybe 'individual requests' or 'requests with low concurrency'

Ravi: +1 for clarity. technically batch size/arrival rate affect tail. if possible call out 'works best under concurrency' otherwise people assume it always helps. B is more explicit about p95/p99 but a lot of users won't know those terms.

Jordan: from PM perspective, we should avoid p95/p99 in the primary tooltip. maybe keep p95 mention in the aria or a linked help doc. also consider adding a short link: 'Learn more' that opens docs on batching heuristics.

copybot: suggestion (short + screen-reader):
Primary: "Save token cost by batching concurrent requests. May increase latency for single requests."
ARIA: "Batching groups concurrent requests to reduce per-token cost; it can increase latency for individual requests and may affect tail percentiles under bursty traffic. See docs for details."

Tom: that looks good. one more micro-nit: 'Save token cost' -> 'Reduce token cost' reads better imo.

Aisha: updated final candidate for UI (fits width): "Reduce token cost by batching concurrent requests. May increase latency for individual requests."
ARIA (expanded): "Batching groups concurrent requests to reduce per-token cost; it can increase latency for individual requests and affect tail latency under bursty workloads. See docs for details."

Ravi: approved — accurate and avoids jargon in main tooltip. Thanks.

Jordan: approved, add small 'Learn more' link to modal that shows examples and when to use/off.

Tom: implemented in branch `feat/ui/batching-tooltip` and added aria text. leaving a tiny CSS tweak to avoid tooltip truncation. :thumbsup:

Aisha: awesome, thanks team — moving to QA. :sparkles:
